command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline: module status =="
lsmod | grep -E '^usb_storage' || echo "usb_storage not currently loaded"

echo "== writing blacklist config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
blacklist usb-storage
install usb-storage /bin/false
EOF
cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "== attempting to unload module if loaded =="
if lsmod | grep -qE '^usb_storage'; then
  sudo -n modprobe -r usb_storage || echo "could not remove module (may be in use)"
else
  echo "nothing to unload"
fi

echo "== updating initramfs so blacklist applies at boot =="
sudo -n update-initramfs -u

echo "== verify modprobe refuses to load it now =="
sudo -n modprobe usb-storage 2>&1 || echo "modprobe correctly blocked/failed as expected"
lsmod | grep -E '^usb_storage' || echo "confirmed: usb_storage not loaded after modprobe attempt"

echo "== done =="
